description:
## VK Video 1.163 (51920) — home/player ad removal r4

Built after real-account screenshots from 1.163.3 confirmed that VK Clips ads were gone, while two other surfaces remained: a native MyTarget showcase card on Home / «Для вас» and a skippable instream ad inside ordinary long videos.

New blockers:
- **Hide home showcase ads** intercepts the catalog factory before AdShowCaseBannerVh is created and returns VK's own EmptyVh instead.
- **Disable video ad repository** replaces VideoAdvertisementsComponentImpl.Q6() with VK's built-in no-op VideoAdvertisementsComponent.STUB repository, which reports no ads and starts no repository-driven ad sessions.

The APK remains Android version 1.163 / 51920 and uses the same project signing certificate as 1.163.3, so it can be installed as an update over the previous project build.

Automated gates passed for Morphe application, ZIP/alignment, package/version, manifest coexistence, DEX application class, ARM64 native signature bypass, and final v3-only signature.

patches.name: Disable ad pixel tracking
patches.description: Stops PixelStatsTrackerImpl from sending individual and batch ad pixels.

patches.name: Disable in-app update
patches.description: Disables the VK Video in-app update check and update prompt.

patches.name: Fix install conflict with stock VK
patches.description: Allows the re-signed VK Video build to coexist with the official VK app.

patches.name: Remove video ads
patches.description: Disables instream video ads and player overlay/motion ad features.
